messages:
alex: Quick flag: the /chat/complete endpoint examples show metadata as an object in the request body, but the runtime actually expects metadata to be sent as a header (x-rw-metadata). Docs and curl example disagree. Need a short fix and note.

priya: Oof. That explains flaky examples in the sample app. Runtime accepts the header and ignores body.metadata. We should standardize on header usage, but keep a migration note for folks who already include it in the JSON.

alex: Plan: update API ref example to put metadata in headers for curl and show equivalent SDK pattern in python/ts. Add a sentence in the schema docs: "For performance, send metadata in x-rw-metadata header; body.metadata will be deprecated." Also add a brief migration snippet.

tony: If we change wording to say body.metadata deprecated, we should coordinate with the deprecation schedule. Product ok with soft deprecation (docs-only) for now. I'll file a short RFC to schedule actual validation change next quarter.

lina: Heads-up: OpenAPI currently defines metadata as nullable object on the request body. Changing that text needs a corresponding description change in the schema but we should not remove the field yet to avoid breaking generated examples. Suggest: mark deprecated: true in schema description and add header example.

alex: I'll open a docs PR with the header-first examples and migration note. PR will include a cURL snippet demonstrating the header and an SDK snippet: Python requests example and TS fetch snippet.

priya: Also add a tiny example for how to JSON-encode metadata into header: `x-rw-metadata: {"user_tier":"pro","request_id":"abc123"}` and note URL-encoding/quoting as needed. Might be helpful to show base64 encoding too.

alex: Good idea. I'll add both raw JSON in header example and a base64-encoded variant with a one-liner to decode in node/python.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR 5678 created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5678. Staging preview at https://deploy-preview-5678--docs.redwood.ai.

tony: Quick review: please ensure examples show header name exactly `x-rw-metadata` (lowercase) and mention the 8KB header size guidance.

lina: Added a suggestion in the PR to annotate the OpenAPI schema with `deprecated` in the property description rather than removing the field. This keeps codegens intact.

priya: Also adding a short migration line: "If you previously relied on body.metadata, move to header and URL-encode or base64-encode large objects to avoid header parsing issues."

alex: PR updated per feedback. Also added test harness: a tiny integration snippet used by docs preview to ensure both header and body variants return equivalent responses for now.

docs-bot: docs-bot: preview tests passed, examples render correctly.

tony: LGTM from infra side. Priya, Lina — you have final docs LGTM?

lina: LGTM, thanks. Priya?

priya: LGTM, merge when ready.

alex: Merged. Will follow up in the RFC thread about enforcement next quarter. Thanks all :rocket:
